text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Her moves have lost their sharpness 
after all. The weight gain boosted her 
power, but at the cost of her speed."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
This is a grave situation. I must get my 
weight back down immediately.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Hello, Yaeno-san. Looks like we're both 
putting our all into training!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Um, do you have some time later? I baked 
some rice crackers and was wondering if 
you'd like to share them.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I actually made a spicy version 
just for Yaeno-san!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my! Thank you so much for going out of 
your way for me. I'm really looking 
forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'll drop by later~!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I cannot turn down Chiyono O-san's 
kindness. I'll just have to lose enough 
weight to make up for these rice crackers!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki's resolve was unyielding, and 
her diet turned out to be a resounding 
success.
